going_concern.quote: 2014-15, Disclosure of Uncertainties about an Entity’s Ability to Continue as a Going Concern (Subtopic 205-40), the Company has concluded there are conditions and events, considered in the aggregate, that raise substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern

financing_terms.price_reset_warrants: In addition, the January 2026 Series B Common Warrants did not meet the equity scope exception under ASC 815-40 due to the exercise price reset feature described below.
